IC1.IC1.4: Ovarian, endometrial or cervical - Gynecologic Oncology Group (GOG) performance score ≤2

IC2.IC2.1: If female and of childbearing potential, are willing to use adequate contraception (hormonal, barrier method, abstinence) prior to study entry and for the duration of study participation.

IC3.IC3.1: Normal organ function within 14 days of study entry

IC4.IC4.1: Diagnosis of one of the following malignancies:

IC5.IC5.1: Measurable metastatic disease (>1cm) in at least one site other than bone-only

IC6.IC6.1: Progression on or failure to respond to at least one previous chemotherapy regimen for metastatic disease

IC7.IC7.1: Progression on prior therapy with a hormonal agent if estrogen receptor or progesterone receptor positive, and/or with trastuzumab if HER2-neu positive.
IC7.IC7.2: If patient has progressed through hormone or trastuzumab therapy only, must have received one chemotherapy regimen.

IC8.IC8.1: Measurable metastatic disease as defined by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST)

IC9.IC9.1: Primary tumor must have been diagnosed histologically as either epithelial ovarian cancer, fallopian tube cancer, or primary peritoneal cancer (not borderline or low malignant potential epithelial carcinoma).

IC10.IC10.1: Subjects must have failed at least two previous chemotherapy regimens.
IC10.IC10.2: Paclitaxel must have been a component of one or both regimens and cisplatin or carboplatin must have been a component of one or both regimens.

IC12.IC12.1: Histologically proven recurrent or persistent endometrial cancer that is not amenable to curative treatment with surgery and/or radiation therapy AND has failed 2 previous treatment regimens

IC14.IC14.1: Histologically proven recurrent or persistent squamous cell carcinoma, adenosquamous carcinoma, or adenocarcinoma of the cervix that is not amenable to curative treatment with surgery and/or radiation therapy AND has failed 2 previous treatment regimens.

EC1.EC1.2: Systemic corticosteroids (oral or injectable) within 7 days of first dose of 852A (topical or inhaled steroids are allowed)
EC1.EC1.3: Investigational drugs/agents within 14 days of first dose of 852A
EC1.EC1.4: Immunosuppressive therapy, including cytotoxic agents within 14 days of first dose of 852A (nitrosoureas within 30 days of first dose)
EC1.EC1.5: Drugs known to induce QT interval prolongation and/or induce Torsades de pointes unless best available drug required to treat life-threatening conditions

EC2.EC2.1: Radiotherapy within 3 weeks of the first dose of 852A
EC2.EC2.2: Hematopoietic cell transplantation within 4 weeks of first dose of 852A

EC3.EC3.1: Evidence of active infection within 3 days of first dose of 852A
EC3.EC3.2: Active fungal infection or pulmonary infiltrates (prior treated disease stable for 2 weeks is allowable)

EC4.EC4.1: Cardiac ischemia, cardiac arrhythmias or congestive heart failure uncontrolled by medication

EC5.EC5.1: History of, or clinical evidence of, a condition which, in the opinion of the investigator, could confound the results of the study or put the subject at undue risk

EC7.EC7.1: Active autoimmune disease requiring immunosuppressive therapy within 30 days
EC7.EC7.2: Active coagulation disorder not controlled with medication

EC9.EC9.1: Concurrent malignancy (if in remission, at least 5 years disease free) except for localized (in-situ) disease, basal carcinomas and cutaneous squamous cell carcinomas that have been adequately treated

EC10.EC10.1: Any history of brain metastases or any other active central nervous system (CNS) disease
